Class BlazeBiteService

public without sharing class BlazeBiteService

Service class for BlazeBite business logic operations. Handles the assignment of orders to payments based on account and payee relationships, matching orders to payments by timestamp proximity.

public static List<Database.SaveResult> assignOrdersToPayments()

Assigns Order2__c records to Payment2__c records by creating OrderPayment__c junction records. Matches orders to payments based on account, payee ID, and timestamp proximity. Orders are matched to the payment whose DatabaseCreatedDate__c is closest to but after the order's creation date.

Returns:
    Database.SaveResult[]: Array of save results from inserting OrderPayment__c records, or null if no matches were found
